notes:
328 UI S1-S4: shared design foundation and semantic colors; reusable PageHeader/EmptyState/Section/Alert; history/report/growth UX closure. History preserves five existing result types, GET filters and 12-item pagination, with grouping within the current page. Failed reads are not empty lists; zero unverified insights is not claimed to prove all evidence verified. Growth charts label independent scales, full dates and units, never zero-fill missing data, and preserve AI quota confirmation. Report disclosures retain default collapse, hash/sidebar/mobile navigation, filter clearing before revealing hidden items, and mutually exclusive issue/plan navigation. Outer sections and inner evidence stay mounted for complete print/PDF.

Relative to deployed v0.2.35 commit 7c54004d8ec58145520c1559e3988dabb99a8649: no API runtime source, schema migration, shared-type contract, dependency, workflow or bootstrap control changes. Standard encrypted backup, idempotent migration verification, digest/commit and health checks are still mandatory. v0.2.35 application rollback is compatible; no database downgrade is attempted. Official updater must preserve pinned retention-aware backup and attachment-cleanup services.

The uncommitted workbench/NavBar/data/public/Docker/Feishu line is excluded; its known mobile overflow is not fixed in this release. API verification: 2379 passed / 222 skipped / 0 failed; workspace typecheck; Chrome growth/history/report 32/148/67, issue-filter 39/39, historical pages 173/173, complete A4 PDF. Node 24 candidate success does not substitute for mandatory Node 22 Docker and tag-triggered release CI. Production evidence follows in docs/328-UI-v0.2.36-Release-and-Production-Upgrade-2026-11-14.md. No runner/bridge installation, WordPress write, AI call or monitoring change is part of this release.
